verdict.rationale: Cline supports MCP servers to connect external tools/data sources (cline-docs-16), and can be chatted with via Slack (cline-docs-17), which covers general extensibility, but there's no explicit documentation of first-party or community MCP integrations for Jira, Slack task context, or Google Drive specifically for extending coding context. missing for 10: explicit Jira integration, explicit Google Drive integration, named community MCP servers for these tools, and evidence of them being used to extend agent context rather than just chat access.
